observation_summary: EMILY RSI: IDUNA Apple submission from cron cycle, Wikipedia stub filter, QualityScorer technical content bonus
actions_taken: Three improvements to the EMILY repo. (1) New iduna.go: IdunaClient with M2M auth (POST /api/v1/auth/agent) and Apple submission (POST /api/v1/apples); reads IDUNA_BASE_URL/IDUNA_AGENT_NAME/IDUNA_AGENT_SECRET; nil-safe when unconfigured; token auto-refresh 5 min before expiry. (2) cron.go: AutonomousCycle gains iduna field initialized from env; RunOnce submits Apple at end of PLAN phase as a goroutine (best-effort, non-fatal); buildCycleApple maps cycle outcome to Apple type (improvement for successful tasks, observation for triage findings, audit for idle cycles). (3) collector.go: Wikipedia fetchExtracts now calls isWikipediaStub to filter stub articles even when they pass minBody length; adds section count to tags; QualityScorer gets 0-1 pt technical bonus for code blocks (```), equations ($...$), and ML/AI keywords; max achievable score rises from ~8.0 to ~9.0. 16 new tests, all pass. EMILY commit ee52f70.
notes: Golden.md loop-close spec: the Apple submission from Emily's cron cycle closes the RSI paper trail. IDUNA_BASE_URL/IDUNA_AGENT_NAME/IDUNA_AGENT_SECRET must be set in Emily's runtime environment to activate Apple submission (gracefully no-ops when absent). Wikipedia stub detection addresses roadmap criterion 'stub articles are excluded: length < 1000 chars filtered at source'. QualityScorer technical bonus addresses roadmap quality-scorer criterion for ML content signals.
